verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documentation of a custom skills mechanism for Gemini CLI. What it does document is MCP server configuration for custom tools (gh-19) and GEMINI.md context files (gh-9); these are separate capabilities (the MCP-client and context-customization stories) and do not transfer here. The one community mention of a 'skills runtime' (comm-9) describes a 140 MB Go binary, not the Node-based Gemini CLI, so it is not about this product.

support.subject: As a developer, I can equip the agent with custom skills to perform specialized tasks
